damage.behavior: Formula damage (the default) scales a baseline by power and by an attack-vs-defence advantage. The baseline is max HP at the attacker's level divided by base hits. Attack and defence are the square roots of the caster's Offence and the target's Defence plus double-weighted lower generals, with negatives treated as 0. The advantage is 1 when both sides are 0 and is otherwise clamped between 0.01 and 10. Static and percentage damage use effective power as a flat number, and percentage power is capped at 100. A non-zero dmgModifier, the highest-power matching Weakness and, on later-round ticks, a non-zero residualModifier multiply the number. An instant hit through a barrier loses the barrier's share. It then runs the damage pipeline: the attacker's Curse bonus, increases, the 50% system reduction and other reductions, a floor at 10% of the post-system hit, static modifiers, keystones, and finally bloodline modifiers, subject to Seal and the allowBloodline opt-outs. With rounds 0 it hits on cast. With rounds above 0 the casting action deals nothing; it then ticks as residual damage (x residualModifier, no barrier cut) once per round on the holder's first action of each later round. A round in which the holder doesn't act gives no tick.

diffuse.in_game_text: Defer a percentage of incoming damage over subsequent turns (non-lethal hits only: a hit that would kill before shields and damage reduction is not deferred). Damage reduction applies before deferral; shields and absorption apply to the immediate portion. Repayment survives expiry, bypasses defenses, and respects Final Stand. diffuse.behavior: While active (rounds above 0 and not sealed, from the action it is cast), the holder defers part of the damage aimed at them in each action. Only their strongest Diffuse counts, at most 99%, using its delayRounds (1-20, default 3). It is all or nothing per action. All HP damage, reflect and recoil heading to the holder in that action are added up, and if the total reaches current HP (shields not counted), nothing is deferred. For that test, ordinary and residual damage are recomputed without the holder's damage reduction but with the 50% system reduction, all increases and any Parry split. Everything else (Pierce, wound, afterburn, drain, poison, reflect, recoil) counts as it stands. When the test passes, power% of each already-reduced packet becomes debt. The debt is repaid in equal parts on the holder's own actions over their next delayRounds acting rounds, at the start of the action. Repayment skips shields, damage reduction and Absorb, respects Final Stand, and continues after the effect ends. The immediate part goes through shields and Final Stand as ordinary damage. That includes Pierce, which shields then soak instead of breaking unless positive Reflect is still on that Pierce hit when mitigation runs (the attacker's own Diffuse deferring the Reflect moves it off the hit), and afterburn, drain and poison, which otherwise skip both. Absorb and Lifesteal only see the immediate part. It can't be cleansed, prevented or copied.

pierce.behavior: Pierce computes its raw number the same way as Damage: formula, static or percentage, with dmgModifier, residualModifier, Weakness, and the barrier cut on instant hits. It resolves after the damage pipeline, so no Curse bonus, damage increase, damage reduction or damage floor applies. It reads the stats from before the action's main pass, so a stat change resolved in the same action doesn't reach it. It isn't soaked by shields. Instead it sets every enabled shield on the target to 0, and Final Stand still applies. If the target's Diffuse defers part of it, shields soak the immediate part like ordinary damage and are destroyed only if positive Reflect is still on that Pierce hit when mitigation runs (if the attacker's own Diffuse defers that Reflect, it moves to a separate hit and the shields survive). Parry, Recoil and Afterburn ignore Pierce. Lifesteal, Absorb, Reflect, Wound and Vamp read an instant Pierce hit, and Lifesteal, Absorb and Reflect skip their general filter for it. wound.in_game_text: Applies wound damage over multiple turns based on damage dealt
wound.behavior: When cast, it records the damage its caster dealt to the target in that action (instant Pierce included). Each later round it deals power% of that recorded hit again. Ticking in its own consequence, that damage skips shields but not Final Stand; merged into another consequence from the same caster (a residual tick, drain or poison), it is soaked by shields like that host, and destroys them if the host is Pierce. It's mirror-eligible.
